issues.description: Compile RPC bloated by shipping entire script content in every response instead of using a dedicated download endpoint.
issues.detail: The compile_notebook RPC already returns pipeline_package_path; adding script_content duplicates on-disk state into every response, wasting memory/bandwidth and silently broadening the contract. Add a separate download/read-script RPC that streams the file on demand by path, keeping the compile response a small metadata envelope.

issues.description: Download icon renders unconditionally in success branch with no guard against missing compiledContent.
issues.detail: handleDownloadClick guards on compiledContent but the icon is rendered whenever the success branch hits. If compiledContent is absent (older backend, partial response, error path), the click is a silent no-op with no user feedback. Gate rendering on compiledContent or show a disabled state.

issues.description: Full script content drilled through three layers of React state purely to feed a click-time Blob.
issues.detail: compiledContent threads through DeployProgressState, DeploysProgress, DeployProgress, and Commands alongside compiledPath when one identifier would do. This complects render-progress with file-download mechanics and stores arbitrary-sized file bodies in UI state. Extract a download utility and fetch content on click by path.

issues.description: Script file opened without explicit encoding or error handling after successful compile.
issues.detail: open(script_path) relies on the platform default encoding and has no try/except. A post-success IOError, missing file, or non-utf8 locale will fail the entire compile_notebook RPC even though compilation already succeeded. Specify encoding='utf-8' and wrap the read so a read failure does not poison a successful compile.

issues.description: Download icon is a clickable SVG instead of a real button or anchor, breaking keyboard access.
issues.detail: GetAppIcon has onClick and a title but no role, no keyboard handler, no focus ring. The adjacent 'Done' affordance is an anchor for a reason. Wrap in IconButton or use <a download> with an object URL to match the surrounding controls and restore keyboard reachability.

synthesis.summary: Panel verdict: NEEDS-WORK. The feature is reasonable but the data shape is wrong — shipping the entire compiled script body through every compile_notebook RPC response and drilling it through three React layers, when a path already exists and a dedicated download endpoint would compose cleanly. The backend read lacks both an explicit utf-8 encoding and error handling, so a post-success read failure poisons the compile result. The frontend renders the download icon without gating on compiledContent and uses an SVG as a click target instead of a real button/anchor. Fix: strip script_content from the compile response, add an on-demand read/download RPC, gate the icon on content presence, and make it a proper keyboard-reachable control.
